name: @sauce/swap
description: SauceScript swaps whose route a service builds when the program compiles. EVM: `kyber` runs KyberSwap's router calldata, `eco` runs an eco-swap program as the Pot. SVM: `jupiter` and `eco` CPI one instruction whose accounts ride as the program's remaining accounts. A program writes `kyberSwap(...)`/`jupiterSwap(...)`/`ecoSwap(...)`, which the SDK's host lowers to these with the route put in. `main` names the NEUTRAL BASE the compiler suffixes per target (swap.evm.js / swap.svm.js); there is no swap.js.
